package controllers

import akka.actor.typed.ActorRef
import akka.util.Timeout
import example.bankwealth.v2.application.aggregates.CreditBalanceProtocol
import example.bankwealth.v2.application.aggregates.FundOrderProtocol
import example.bankwealth.v2.application.aggregates.FundQuotaProtocol
import example.bankwealth.v2.application.aggregates.repository.CreditBalanceRepository
import example.bankwealth.v2.application.aggregates.repository.FundOrderRepository
import example.bankwealth.v2.application.aggregates.repository.FundQuotaRepository
import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities.CreditBalanceEntity
import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities.FundOrderEntity
import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities.FundQuotaEntity
import example.bankwealth.v2.infrastructure.api.{ApiError, Endpoint, IdGuard}
import javax.inject.{Inject, Singleton}
import play.api.libs.json.{JsArray, JsBoolean, JsNull, JsNumber, JsObject, JsString, JsValue, Json, OWrites}
import play.api.mvc.{Action, AnyContent, BaseController, ControllerComponents}
import scala.concurrent.{ExecutionContext, Future}
import scala.concurrent.duration._

/** Multi-aggregate write-side consistent state query controller (uses <Agg>Protocol.GetState + qualified <Agg>Entity.State). */
@Singleton
class AggregateStateApiController @Inject()(
  api: Endpoint,
  fundQuotaRepository: FundQuotaRepository,
  fundOrderRepository: FundOrderRepository,
  creditBalanceRepository: CreditBalanceRepository,
  val cc: ControllerComponents
)(implicit ec: ExecutionContext) extends BaseController {

  override def controllerComponents: ControllerComponents = cc
  private implicit val timeout: Timeout = Timeout(5.seconds)

  private def anyToJson(v: Any): JsValue = v match {
    case null             => JsNull
    case None             => JsNull
    case Some(inner)      => anyToJson(inner)
    case s: String        => JsString(s)
    case b: Boolean       => JsBoolean(b)
    case n: Int           => JsNumber(BigDecimal(n))
    case n: Long          => JsNumber(BigDecimal(n))
    case n: BigDecimal    => JsNumber(n)
    case m: Map[_, _]     => JsObject(m.map { case (k, vv) => k.toString -> anyToJson(vv) }.toSeq)
    case seq: Iterable[_] => JsArray(seq.map(anyToJson).toSeq)
    case other            => JsString(other.toString)
  }

  private implicit val writesFundQuotaState: OWrites[FundQuotaEntity.State] = (st: FundQuotaEntity.State) => Json.obj(
    "minPurchase" -> anyToJson(st.minPurchase),
    "maxSingleLimit" -> anyToJson(st.maxSingleLimit),
    "fundTotalUsed" -> anyToJson(st.fundTotalUsed),
    "fundTotalCap" -> anyToJson(st.fundTotalCap),
    "perAccountCap" -> anyToJson(st.perAccountCap),
    "accountUsed" -> anyToJson(st.accountUsed)
  )

  private implicit val writesFundOrderState: OWrites[FundOrderEntity.State] = (st: FundOrderEntity.State) => Json.obj(
    "netAmount" -> anyToJson(st.netAmount),
    "paymentOutcome" -> anyToJson(st.paymentOutcome),
    "taStatus" -> anyToJson(st.taStatus)
  )

  private implicit val writesCreditBalanceState: OWrites[CreditBalanceEntity.State] = (st: CreditBalanceEntity.State) => Json.obj(
    "availableAmount" -> anyToJson(st.availableAmount),
    "reservedTotal" -> anyToJson(st.reservedTotal),
    "reservedByTx" -> anyToJson(st.reservedByTx)
  )

  def fundQuota(id: String): Action[AnyContent] =
    api.global.read().apply[FundQuotaEntity.State] { (_, _) =>
      IdGuard.parse(id, "fundQuotaId") match {
        case Right(validId) =>
          fundQuotaRepository.entityRefFor(validId).ask { (replyTo: ActorRef[FundQuotaEntity.State]) =>
            FundQuotaProtocol.GetState(replyTo)
          }.map(st => Right(st): Either[ApiError, FundQuotaEntity.State])
        case Left(err) =>
          Future.successful(Left(err): Either[ApiError, FundQuotaEntity.State])
      }
    }

  def fundOrder(id: String): Action[AnyContent] =
    api.global.read().apply[FundOrderEntity.State] { (_, _) =>
      IdGuard.parse(id, "fundOrderId") match {
        case Right(validId) =>
          fundOrderRepository.entityRefFor(validId).ask { (replyTo: ActorRef[FundOrderEntity.State]) =>
            FundOrderProtocol.GetState(replyTo)
          }.map(st => Right(st): Either[ApiError, FundOrderEntity.State])
        case Left(err) =>
          Future.successful(Left(err): Either[ApiError, FundOrderEntity.State])
      }
    }

  def creditBalance(id: String): Action[AnyContent] =
    api.global.read().apply[CreditBalanceEntity.State] { (_, _) =>
      IdGuard.parse(id, "creditBalanceId") match {
        case Right(validId) =>
          creditBalanceRepository.entityRefFor(validId).ask { (replyTo: ActorRef[CreditBalanceEntity.State]) =>
            CreditBalanceProtocol.GetState(replyTo)
          }.map(st => Right(st): Either[ApiError, CreditBalanceEntity.State])
        case Left(err) =>
          Future.successful(Left(err): Either[ApiError, CreditBalanceEntity.State])
      }
    }

}
